status: P3 = CLOSED → SYSTEM DIRECTION VALIDATED / TRAINING NOT AUTHORIZED

P3-A.meaning: Model alone insufficient (R2 17/20 breached by scale; T4 9/20 fails — walls dissociated)

P3-B.meaning: Diversity alone insufficient (R2 union ceiling 3/20; T4 consensus floor 30%)

P3-C.meaning: System-level approach works (Qwen + frozen pipeline: T4 20/20, R2 20/20, 0 FA)

P3-D.meaning: Dataset does not justify training (5/10 readiness dimensions fail)

key_conclusion: P3 provides evidence that improving the verification system is currently more valuable than training a new model.

binding_constraints.direction: Generate positives ONLY via the validated recipe (strong model inside the structured pipeline); count only verifier-passing trajectories toward the 1000

binding_constraints.constraint: 2 task families, 1 synthetic design family, 0 real families
binding_constraints.direction: Add a third task family and a second, REAL design family first — volume without this is explicitly insufficient per the frozen rule

binding_constraints.constraint: No third-wall trajectory corpus (R5 exists only as a finding document)
binding_constraints.direction: Build full R5 (or equivalent) generation→verification trajectories with frozen labels before any training claim
Cut and freeze a held-out split (cases never train-eligible, scored only by frozen verifiers) BEFORE further data generation, so all future data is born separated

binding_constraints.constraint: No recorded cost/benefit case for GPU expenditure
binding_constraints.direction: Record the training-economics memo once the other four move: expected capability gain x generality vs GPU cost at projected scale

data_generation_rule: Constraint-driven, not volume-driven: each new trajectory must be tied to one of the five binding constraints above and carry machine-verifiable evidence. The P3-D result proves additional positives alone do not move the constraints that matter.
next_phase: Targeted dataset/harness improvements against the five constraints → re-measure with the frozen assessor (scripts/p3d_readiness_v2.py) → reassess training readiness. No training until a re-assessment returns READY, followed by a separate P4 authorization.
method: Readout of frozen track verdicts; no new measurement, no re-grading, no post-hoc change. Consistency with underlying verdict files is enforced by test_p3_overall_gate.py.
